subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient Name], We are pleased to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to London. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB123 Date: 15th September 2022 Departure Time: 10:00 AM Arrival Time: 2:00 PM We recommend arriving at the airport at least 2 hours before the departure time. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Best regards, The Flight Booking Team
